items.source: Determines what type of existing DataSource bean can be replaced.
items.translation: 确定可以替换的现有 DataSource Bean 的类型。

items.source: Annotation that can be applied to a test class to configure a test database to use instead of the application-defined or auto-configured DataSource. In the case of multiple DataSource beans, only the @Primary DataSource is considered.
items.translation: 可用于配置测试数据库以替代应用程序定义或自动配置的 DataSource 的注解。在存在多个 DataSource Bean 的情况下，仅考虑 @Primary DataSource。

items.source: The type of connection to be established when replacing the DataSource.
items.translation: 要建立的连接类型，当replacing DataSource 时。

items.source: The type of connection to be established when replacing the DataSource. By default, will attempt to detect the connection based on the classpath.
items.translation: 要建立的连接类型，当replacing DataSource 时。默认情况下，将尝试根据 classpath 检测连接。

items.source: the type of existing DataSource to replace
items.translation: 要替换的现有 DataSource 类型

items.source: the type of connection to use
What the test database can replace.
items.translation: 测试数据库可替代的内容。
